title: College lab class ends with 32 people on antibiotics for deadly germ exposure
summary: A bizarre series of events in a college microbiology lab class left 33 people—including students, professors, and lab workers—believing they were exposed to a deadly germ. University officials determined that 33 people linked to the lab class had been exposed.
